harness_history.detail: Using --decorations=never in piped mode left loop_through enabled, so Bat selected SimplePrinter and bypassed the character-wrapping owner. All fixtures remained intact in that generation.

conclusion: Exact Bat source splits the ZWJ extended grapheme 👩‍💻 between its component scalars under public character wrapping at terminal width 2. A single two-column scalar stays intact at the same width, and the ZWJ sequence stays intact when the terminal width is 4.
remaining_gate: Evaluate an EGC-aware wrapping repair in the owned Bat fork while preserving control-character width and word-wrap whitespace semantics.
